To look at this code on your machine, run these commands. The first one makes a clone, if this folder has none:

```bash
[ -d smallwikiapp ] || git clone https://github.com/rahuldave/smallwikiapp
cd smallwikiapp
git fetch --quiet --tags --force origin
git switch --detach 5873353449ad
```

```bash
just setup
```

In the code now, `__init__.py` asks for the version of `"wikiapp"` by name, which fixes the one problem that
[ty](https://docs.astral.sh/ty/), the type checker, found. A family of rules, `ANN`, asks for a type on every parameter and return. The code and the tests have
their types.

`just check` does not run the type checker yet. One line in `check` runs it.

## 5.7 The recipe check runs the type checker {#step-05.7}

`just check` is what a person and the git hook run before git records a change, and it does not run ty yet. So a
change can break a type, and pass. The recipe `check` now runs `just types` after `just lint`, and its comment
names the types too.

[± See the change to `justfile`](#step-05.7-justfile-424f0b-diff){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

In the `justfile`, the recipe `check` now runs `just types` on line 74, after `just lint`. Its comment, on line 65,
lists "types".

```bash
just check
```

Every check passes, the type check among them. The coverage is 96.88%.

`.pre-commit-config.yaml` still says `entry: just check`, and the hook now
checks the types too.
